title: A Trip to the Zoo
description: Linh and her family have a fun day at the zoo.
instructions: Read about Linh's day at the zoo. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🦁 Last Saturday, Linh went to the zoo with her brother Nam and her mum. They went by bus. It was a sunny day.
First, they saw the monkeys. The monkeys were very funny. One monkey ate a banana and jumped on a tree.
Next, they went to see the elephants. The elephants were the biggest animals in the zoo. Nam took a photo of a baby elephant.
At twelve o'clock, they were hungry. They sat on a bench and ate sandwiches and apples. Linh gave an apple to Nam.
🐧 After lunch, they walked to the penguins. The penguins swam in the cold water. Linh liked the penguins best because they were so cute.
At three o'clock, they bought a small toy penguin in the shop. Then they went home. Linh was tired but very happy.
